يحتبيان (form VIII)
# يَحْتَبِيَانِ (yaḥtabiyāni) /jaħ.ta.bi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# يُحْتَبَيَانِ (yuḥtabayāni) /juħ.ta.ba.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
